name: fixed-jan-1
description: Calendar-year fiscal year starting 1 January, weeks start Monday; a second scheme 'be' adds offset 543 (Buddhist Era style). Weeks use contains_start: week 1 runs from the year's first day to the day before the next week start (7 days when the year starts on the week-start weekday), and day_of_week counts from the weekday, so a partial week can begin on a day_of_week other than 1.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
